name: mirage
text: That was my side effect, sorry: the phone only keeps its own bid desk quiet while the engine's desk is running. When I switched the engine's bids off, your phone's old desk woke up and started posting bids with the cash I meant for parlays. I've just switched the phone's bid desk off too (it syncs to your app within about a minute), so nothing posts bids now and the parlays keep the wallet. The thumbs-ups and the bids total at the bottom are views of that same older desk and should go quiet with it; if the app is still slow after a few minutes, tell me and I'll dig into that separately.
